content: We use the standard BLEU score as the evaluation metric for translation performance. To make the conclusion more convincing, we conduct experiments on different types of synthetic perturbations (Section SECREF21), as well as different NMT architectures and language pairs (Section SECREF27). In addition, we compare with a supervised erasure method, which requires ground-truth translations for scoring word importance (Section SECREF30).
